note: TypedMultipartWithLimits<T, ..> documents a multipart/form-data request body, can be wrapped in Validated / ValidatedWith and derefs to T like TypedMultipart. Unknown and nameless multipart parts ignored in non-strict mode are drained through the meter, so their bytes count against max_total_bytes. MeteredField::headers exposes the part headers to custom field parsers. vespera_core: deserializing type: [T, "null"] keeps the null next to a oneOf with a {type: null} branch, a not of a non-null schema or an allOf of {type: null}; OpenApi::merge keeps the path-level parameters / servers written next to an inlined #/components/pathItems reference, and an unresolvable receiver reference no longer adopts incoming path-level parameters / servers. jni_apps! docs name the "_default" entry as the way to register the default app.
